comments.text: Watched this movie a long long time ago. Knew the repercussions of addictions. Yet I couldn't save myself from it.
comments.author: sauravbang595

comments.text: Reminds me of the chaos that comes with opioid withdrawals as days 1-3 progressively become more and more chaotic and then the storm/chaos begins to settle slowly with more and more relief after making it passed day 4.... its like the song explains it but without words. A storm that spirals out of control and then slowly begins to settle down. Requiem for a dream was a fantastic movie for pairing this song to it.
